core_obligations: With the cited subpolar screening/Nichols correspondence and standard Selberg/Kadell formulas supplied, the author must continue ordered nonlocal contour-integral coefficients beyond their convergence chamber, retain boundary terms in the recursive continuation, control possible pole orders for all mode-polynomial partitions, and combine the asymmetric A2 Selberg expression with the three-variable recursion over complementary parameter ranges. The actual quantum-symmetrizer factor has a double zero at negative half-integers, canceling the remaining simple pole and establishing the Serre relation for the original m not inZ range. This nontrivial interaction of multivalued contour continuation, special-function poles and braided operator relations is oneH3 result; the recurrence and short scalar estimates are not separate counts.
